name: anyrun-threat-intelligence-feeds
label: ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Feeds
description:
The ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Feeds connector FortiSOAR users with continuously updated, high-fidelity IOCs (malicious IPs, domains, and URLs) extracted from live sandbox analyses across 15,000+ SOCs. This enables proactive defense against emerging threats with rich context including sandbox session links for faster triage and response.

With TI Feeds, you SOC can ensure: - Early threat detection using real-time IOCs from the latest emerging malware & phishing, catching attacks hours before they hit. - More effective Tier 1 as analysts will be able to resolve more alerts without escalation thanks to clear indicator context. - Lightning-fast MTTR with TTPs and behavior insights from sandbox reports, enabling automated triage and response in minutes.

This connector has a dependency on the Threat Intel Management Solution Pack. Install the Solution Pack before enabling ingestion of Threat Feeds from this source.

fields.title: API Key
fields.description: Specify the API key used to authenticate with the ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Feeds API. The format of the API Key must be: NS9sY..FwvfR.
fields.name: apiKey
fields.tooltip: Specify the API key used to authenticate with the ANY.RUN Threat Intelligence Feeds API. The format of the API Key must be: NS9sY..FwvfR.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is set to True.

operations.title: Fetch Indicators
operations.description: Retrieves indicators of compromise (IOCs) from the ANY.RUN TAXII server for the specified collection, time range, and other input parameters.

parameters.title: Collection type
parameters.description: Specify the type of collection from which to retrieve indicators. Possible values are IP, URL, Domain, or Full.
parameters.name: collectionType
parameters.tooltip: Specify the type of collection from which to retrieve indicators. Possible values are IP, URL, Domain, or Full.

parameters.title: Feed Fetch Depth
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the number of days to retrieve indicators.
parameters.name: feedFetchDepth
parameters.tooltip: Specify the number of days to retrieve indicators.

parameters.title: Process Response As
parameters.description:
(Optional) Select how FortiSOAR should process the retrieved indicators. Available options are: 
-Create as Feed Records in FortiSOAR: Creates Threat Intel Feed records in FortiSOAR. If you select this option, then in the Record Creation Playbook IRI field, specify the IRI of the Record Creation Playbook. 
-Save to File: Saves the retrieved indicators to a file on the FortiSOAR server. If you select this option, then in the Filename field, specify the name of the file in which to save the feed information. -Return as JSON: Returns the retrieved indicators in JSON format. If you select this option, then there are no additional input parameters.
parameters.name: output_mode
parameters.tooltip:

-Save to File: Saves the retrieved indicators to a file on the FortiSOAR server. If you select this option, then in the Filename field, specify the name of the file in which to save the feed information. 
-Return as JSON: Returns the retrieved indicators in JSON format. If you select this option, then there are no additional input parameters.
